question: Who said “a cherry that will drop into our mouth one day” about the kingdom of Awadh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Dalhousie**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lord Dalhousie** made the statement "a cherry that will drop into our mouth one day" about the kingdom of Awadh.
 
• Lord Dalhousie served as the Governor-General of India from 1848 to 1856.
